Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations support premium valuations.

Silver.note: Industrial demand softness offsets precious metal bid, underperforming gold.

Copper.note: Structural grid and EV demand outpaces constrained mine supply growth.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and renewed global nuclear build-outs.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV battery demand growth pressure margins.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surplus and LFP battery substitution weigh on prices.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and mine closures support refined metal prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weakness in Chinese property sector offsets infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Thermal demand peak approaching while seaborne supply remains adequate.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks balanced against near-term demand softness.

Manganese.note: Steady global steel production maintains baseline demand equilibrium.

PGM.note: Substitution effects and long-term internal combustion engine decline.

Potash.note: Global agricultural application rates stabilize post-supply shock.

Aluminum.note: Capacity caps in China and green energy transition drive structural deficit.

Diversified.note: Favorable base metal mix offsets iron ore headwinds and coal declines.
